hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: south Central Europe, Julian Alps between Austria and Croatia || a short southwestern coastal strip of Karst topography on the Adriatic; an alpine mountain region lies adjacent to Italy and Austria in the north; mixed mountains and valleys with numerous rivers to the east || despite its small size, this eastern Alpine country controls some of Europe's major transit routes || Resources: lignite, lead, zinc, building stone, hydropower, forests || Exports: packaged medicine, cars, refined petroleum, vehicle parts/accessories, plastic products (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: a short southwestern coastal strip of Karst topography on the Adriatic; an alpine mountain region lies adjacent to Italy and Austria in the north; mixed mountains and valleys with numerous rivers to the east || south Central Europe, Julian Alps between Austria and Croatia

climate.excerpt: Mediterranean climate on the coast, continental climate with mild to hot summers and cold winters in the plateaus and valleys to the east || flooding; earthquakes

economy.excerpt: high-income EU and eurozone economy; high per-capita income and low inequality; key exports in automotive and pharmaceuticals; tight labor market with low unemployment; growth supported by private consumption and public investment, with risks from tight labor market and trade conditions; narrowing fiscal deficit and declining public debt || Exports: packaged medicine, cars, refined petroleum, vehicle parts/accessories, plastic products (2023) || Industries: ferrous metallurgy and aluminum products, lead and zinc smelting; electronics (including military electronics), trucks, automobiles, electric power equipment, wood products, textiles, chemicals, machine tools
